**Is your extension proposal related to a problem or limitation? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the current VQC-ZTI structure lacks (e.g., missing a parameter-matched classical neural baseline).

**Describe the proposed extension**
A clear description of what you want to add or modify (e.g., adding a new 12-qubit ansatz block, tweaking the robust feature preparation rules, or testing an extra risk-fusion policy engine).

**Ablation / Variant Alignment**
How does this change interact with the current ablation variants (Full Hybrid, No Head, Shallow Embedder, No Embedder, PQC-only)? 

**Additional context**
Add any mathematical formulations, circuit sketches, or structure ideas for conference-ready reporting here.
